decisions: Money (invoicer) and Amount (pettycash) are one concept in two shapes: keep both, with a conversion where they meet (currency: EUR, where: a billable expense becomes an invoice line)
Period (invoicer) and Period (pettycash) are the same thing: one of them serves for both
Expense (pettycash) and LineItem (invoicer) are one concept in two shapes: keep both, with a conversion where they meet -- a billable expense becomes an invoice line
Money (invoicer) and Amount (pettycash) are merged as Monetary amount -- one concept: cents; invoicer's carries a currency
